example (x C k : ℝ) : deriv (fun t : ℝ => C * Real.exp (k * t)) x = k * (C * Real.exp (k * x)) := by
  have hd := ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (k * x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_const_mul k)).const_mul C
  calc
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => C * Real.exp (k * t)) x = C * (Real.exp (k * x) * k) := by simpa [Function.comp_apply] using hd.deriv
    _ = k * (C * Real.exp (k * x)) := by ring
